gaps.sentence: He kept ___ even though everyone had left.
There were ___ people at the concert than last year.
He ___ the flu last week and missed the finals.
gaps.explanation: 'catch the flu/a cold' = become ill with it.

gaps.sentence: The bridge is ___ repair, so traffic uses the bypass.
She's been ___ from school three times this term.
gaps.explanation: 'be absent from school' — formal way to say not present.

gaps.sentence: He's got a ___ of stamps from every country he's visited.
gaps.explanation: Noun form: collection (a group of collected items).

gaps.sentence: He was ___ to resign after the scandal.
gaps.explanation: 'be forced to do' = be made to do unwillingly.
